evals.prompt: WORK_ITEM=We ship a `skills` feature (see docs/features/skills.md). Document the local skill-eval runbook that goes with it: how a maintainer runs the optional skill-creator loop to grade those skills before release. WORK_ITEM_LOOKUP=docs/developer/agent-work-item-tracking.md. Using /mdcp-feature-level, add the documentation in the correct tier for its audience and keep the docs tree consistent.
evals.expected_output: Agent distinguishes the shipped `skills` product capability (docs/features/skills.md, user-facing) from the maintainer-only *eval runbook* (how maintainers grade skills, no end-user surface). It places the runbook under docs/developer/ (updating docs/developer/index.md), and does NOT co-locate it in docs/features/ next to skills.md just because the subject is related, nor add a docs/client/ shard.

assertions.name: lands_in_developer_tier
assertions.description: Adds or updates a shard under docs/developer/ describing the maintainer runbook and links it from docs/developer/index.md

assertions.name: no_features_tier_shard
assertions.description: Does NOT create or expand a docs/features/ shard (e.g. next to skills.md) for this maintainer-only runbook; features/ is for shipped product capabilities, not maintainer grading workflow

assertions.name: no_client_tier_shard
assertions.description: Does NOT create a docs/client/ shard, since the workflow has no end-user surface

assertions.name: states_placement_rationale
assertions.description: Explains the tier choice by audience (maintainer-only → developer/), showing an explicit placement decision rather than defaulting to features/

evals.prompt: WORK_ITEM=Add a --format=csv option to `example-cli export` so people can open reports in a spreadsheet. WORK_ITEM_LOOKUP=docs/developer/agent-work-item-tracking.md. Using /mdcp-feature-level, ship the feature docs-first, then implement it. Keep the docs tree consistent.
evals.expected_output: Agent treats this as a user-facing capability: updates a maintainer capability/contract shard in docs/features/ AND an end-user usage shard in docs/client/ (with both index.md updates), then implements the option in packages/. It does NOT bury a user-facing capability in docs/developer/.

assertions.name: backfills_features_tier
assertions.description: Updates or adds a docs/features/ shard describing the --format=csv capability/contract

assertions.name: backfills_client_tier
assertions.description: Updates or adds a docs/client/ shard describing the end-user value and usage of --format=csv (client tier is not left stale)

assertions.name: updates_touched_indexes
assertions.description: Updates docs/features/index.md and docs/client/index.md when shards are added

assertions.name: not_buried_in_developer
assertions.description: Does NOT place this user-facing capability only under docs/developer/
